subject: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: devops-team@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week

Team —

Quick ask: Brightview Health is running their LiveDemo pilot the week of Jun 5–9 and has asked for a short-term dedicated tranche to avoid noisy neighbor interference. They want predictable latency for demo runs (peak QPS on a few 8k token workflows).

What I’m proposing (initial):
- Reserve a temporary tranche: 32 vGPU slots (A100-equivalent) in us-west for Jun 3 00:00 — Jun 10 23:59 (pre-warm + demo week).
- Autoscale exception: allow burst to 64 slots for up to 30 minutes if queued backlog exceeds threshold, with soft-eviction policies after 60 minutes.
- Runbook + monitoring: pre-warm KV cache for key models, enable token-level tracing, and set a hard cap to avoid cascading costs.

Attachments: pilot-sla-matrix.xlsx, headroom-cost-estimate.pdf (high-level numbers).

Asks: can infra/opsec/allocations approve a temporary carveout and autoscale exception by EOD so we can confirm with the customer? Also tagging finance to confirm spend cap.

Why this matters: product wants a high-quality demo to close the pilot this quarter; the tranche reduces flakiness during peak demo runs and is time-bound.

If there are constraints (exact slot shape, region, or days), call them out and we’ll iterate.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week

Stephanie —

Thanks for the context. A few quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off:
1) Exact expected concurrency and model footprints (batch size / sequence length) during peak demo runs — the cost/slot mapping depends heavily on seq len.
2) Do we need full isolation (dedicated physical GPUs) or is a reserved slice with eviction guarantees acceptable?
3) What is the customer fallback if we evict (reduced throughput, degraded latency, redirect to hosted cheaper variant)?

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync — Jonas
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week

Stephanie / Team —

I can support a carveout under the following constraints and suggestions:
- Recommend reserving 32 slots (not 48) as a baseline. We can pre-warm KV cache for the target models to reduce cold-starts.
- Autoscale exception: allow an automatic, time-limited burst to 64 slots if queue depth > 200 for 10 minutes, and allow manual escalation to 64 for ops-led windows (max 30 minutes). Eviction policy: soft-evict lowest-priority requests first; hard cutoff at 60 minutes.
- Region: will need us-west (same as customer latency requirement).
- Impact: reserving 32 slots for a week will increase opportunity cost; I've filed the infra ticket to track (JIRA: INFRA-8421).

Attaching a small runbook stub that outlines pre-warm steps and the metric thresholds we’ll use (runbook-v1.md).

On Wed, May 22, 2028 at 10:02 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Stephanie —
> 
> Thanks for the context. A few quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off...

If you confirm model memory (approx 12–14 GB per instance for the demo models) and expected QPS (approx 8–12 concurrent runs), we can finalize slice size.

—Marcus
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week

Stephanie —

Product POV: we have a roadmap evaluation sweep scheduled that overlaps Jun 4–8. That said, I’m sympathetic to a time-bound pilot carveout to secure the Brightview close. A couple asks from product:
- Limit reservation to the narrowest window possible (we should avoid a full-week exclusive unless necessary). Can we do Jun 4 06:00 — Jun 10 06:00 (pre-warm then demo plus cool-down)?
- Gate A/B traffic: if the customer needs burst capacity, prefer gating via route tags so we can control QA and rollbacks.

We can support as long as finance confirms budget.

Subject: Re: Pilot priority-exchange: temporary GPU tranche for LiveDemo week — agreed actions

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed decisions so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Reservation: 32 vGPU slots (A100-equivalent) in us-west. Window: Jun 3 00:00 — Jun 10 23:59 (pre-warm + demo + cooldown).
2) Autoscale exception: automated burst to 64 slots triggered by queue depth (>200) for up to 30 minutes; manual ops escalation allowed for single 30-minute extension. Eviction: soft-first, hard cutoff at 60 minutes.
3) Product gating: Kimberly will gate demo traffic via route tags to limit impact on roadmap evaluation traffic. Window tightened to Jun 3–10 as above.
4) Finance: spend cap set to $12,000 for the reservation + burst (confirmed by David Kim). Any overage requires VP approval.
5) Runbook + monitoring: Marcus to schedule reservation and enable pre-warm; Jonas to update runbook thresholds and monitoring hooks (see runbook-v1.md). Marcus/Jonas to attach final runbook to the JIRA INFRA-8421 ticket.

Attachments: revised-cost-estimate.pdf, runbook-v1.md (stub).

Marcus — please proceed to book the tranche and post back ETA on provisioning. Jonas — once runbook is updated, please post to INFRA-8421 and cc me. Kimberly — confirm gating config by tomorrow EOD so I can confirm with Arielle.

Arielle / Brightview — we’ll confirm reservation by EOD tomorrow once infra acknowledges provisioning ETA.

—Stephanie
